text:
sofia (Billing): Hey @mike — FYI customer AcmeCloud says their procurement requires a PO and they will not allow card charges. Invoice INV-2026-0421 attempted CC charge but it failed. They want Net 60. Can we approve without full credit review?

mike (AE): looping @priya (Finance) and @liam (Support). Is there an executed MSA in SF?

sofia (Billing): MSA signed last week (link in CRM). Customer ARR ~ $120k. PO number provided: PO-98765. They attached a screenshot of the bank decline.

billing-bot: Payment attempt declined: `pm_intent: pi_3I5xxxxxx, status: requires_payment_method, decline_code: card_declined, auth_code: 05`

liam (Support): Quick note — we paused usage at 2026-03-17T16:03:20Z per billing-hold. Repro from payments UI: failed capture, provider returned `card_declined`. No retry scheduled. If finance approves, we can lift the hold and re-enable API keys immediately.

priya (Finance): Policy: Net terms >45 days require credit check + CFO approval. For a small account with signed MSA we can do an exception: either (A) accept PO + 25% upfront, remainder Net 30; or (B) temporary short-term credit (30 days) while PO and bank references are collected. Need VAT info if EU.

sofia (Billing): Customer insists procurement cannot do upfront. They claim they're VAT registered (EU). Provided VAT ID: GB123456789. They ask for invoice with reverse-charge note.

legal (Legal): We can add the reverse-charge VAT note to invoice. For Net 60 request we need Legal sign-off; we can expedite if Sales confirms AR contact and company bank reference. Also ask for PO PDF with authorized signature.

mike (AE): Sent options to customer: (1) send signed PO + VAT ID + bank ref and we'll provision a 72h temporary access window while Finance completes review, or (2) provide 25% upfront and Net 30 balance.

sofia (Billing): Customer responded — procurement says PO will take 6–8 business days. They are asking for continuous access until then.

priya (Finance): We will not extend open credit for 8 business days without checks. Finance offers: 72-hour temporary lift (one-time) pending PO scan and bank ref; if documents not received, account auto-suspends. Please collect PO PDF to billing@redwood.com and cc finance@redwood.com.

liam (Support): Implemented temporary lift — API keys unpaused and quota increased for 72h. Noted throttle back if misuse.

sofia (Billing): Updated invoice: added VAT reverse-charge line, appended PO-98765 as pending, and left payment status as "pending". Invoicenote: "Temporary access granted 72h pending PO and bank ref."

mike (AE): Customer asked for Net 60 commitment in writing. I replied that Net 60 requires CFO approval and bank references; we offered the temporary 72h solution.

priya (Finance): Action items recorded: 1) Sales to send PO PDF + bank ref (crm link), 2) Finance to run quick credit check, 3) Legal add VAT reverse-charge and confirm MSA signature. If checks pass, convert to Net 60 with AR terms; if not, suspend after 72h.

sofia (Billing): Customer now says they cannot meet 72h window but asked to escalate to legal. Forwarded legal response.

legal (Legal): Escalation note: we can approve Net 60 on file if customer provides bank reference + supplier reference + signed PO within 10 business days and Sales confirms higher-level sponsor. Otherwise we fallback to temporary credit or require partial upfront.

mike (AE): I told them the same. Customer will escalate internally and try to expedite PO.

sofia (Billing): Closing internal loop — temporary unblock granted, invoice updated with VAT reverse-charge, PO pending. If PO not received by 2026-03-20T09:00:00Z UTC, account will be suspended automatically. Marking this thread as resolved for billing handoff. :white_check_mark:
